lines.en: label makisummer2porngen:
scene makisummer2porngen
I make my way over to the porn shop to find Maki restocking the shelves after some woman came in and purchased nearly her entire inventory of giant rubber penises.
lines.zh: 我溜达到色情用品店，发现 Maki 正在补货——之前有个女人跑进来，把她库存里的大型橡胶阴茎几乎买空了。

lines.en: It was probably Sara. That seems like something she would do.
lines.zh: 大概是 Sara 吧。这种事她干得出来。

lines.en: Maki quickly misunderstands my presence in her store as a call to be lectured about the history of sex toys and their evolution over the past hundreds of years- a thing I don’t really care about knowing.
lines.zh: Maki 很快误会了我出现在店里的意图，把这当成了要听她讲器具的历史、以及几百年来它们如何演变的信号——这种事我其实一点都不想知道。

lines.en: But it is her immense education on the topic that helps me realize where her daughter gets her diligence from.
lines.zh: 不过正是她在这方面的渊博学识，让我明白她女儿那股认真劲儿是随了谁。

lines.en: The only thing is that Makoto’s diligence extends to things beyond sex toys and Maki has now been discussing them for a good fifteen minutes without showing any signs of stopping.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，Makoto 的认真可不止用在器具上，而 Maki 已经滔滔不绝讲了整整十五分钟，毫无要停的意思。

lines.en: I take it upon myself to remind her that my interest in dildos is very limited, which she misinterprets as a desire to learn more about the history of male sex toys.
lines.zh: 我主动提醒她，我对假阳具的兴趣非常有限——结果她把这误解成了我想进一步了解男性器具的历史。

lines.en: scene black
I must wait another fifteen minutes for her to stop talking about those until I finally have an opportunity to tell her that I’m just here to hang out and don’t want to be educated.
lines.zh: 我只好又等了十五分钟，等她讲完那些，才终于找到机会告诉她：我只是来待着的，不想上课。

lines.en: She’s visibly upset by this but understands and ultimately decides to put down the oversized dildo she’d been waving around for the entire conversation and take her place behind the counter instead.
lines.zh: 她明显有点失落，但还是理解了，最后放下那个她整场对话都挥来挥去的超大号假阳具，回到柜台后面站好。

lines.en: The rest of the night proceeds with limited mention of penises (Or as limited as that can be with Maki) while the two of us talk more about her background and how she got to where she is today.
lines.zh: 那天晚上剩下的时间里，阴茎这个词出现的频率算是被控制住了（至少跟 Maki 在一起时能控制到这个程度），我们更多地聊起了她的过去，以及她是怎么走到今天的。

lines.en: Of course, that comes to a screeching halt once she asks about mine.
lines.zh: 当然了，等她问起我的过去时，话题就戛然而止了。

lines.en: Two whole hours manage to pass by without either of us noticing and eventually the time comes for me to head back home and inform my niece that I was not murdered.
lines.zh: 整整两个小时就这么不知不觉过去了，终于到了我该回家的时候——回去告诉我的 [niece]，我没被杀。

lines.en: Maki escorts me to the door and locks up shop in turn, but not before giving me one final (Albeit very brief) history lesson on the origin of the rubber vagina.
lines.zh: Maki 把我送到门口，随后锁了店门，不过在那之前还是给我上了最后一课——虽然很短——关于橡胶阴道的起源。
